.. _examples_control:
  
Geometric Control
=================

`pglfd` contains Simulink libraries for :ref:`SE(3) transformations and filters <pgtrafo>`, :ref:`Riemannian manifolds <pgmanif>` and :ref:`geometric control <pgctrl>`.
Those allow for building real-time controllers leveraging outputs of the probabilistic and geometric models described before.
For example, learned covariances can be used to create impedance controllers on variable-stiffness geometric potentials.
